description: The line plot illustrates the loss values across iterations for five different models: Vanilla, StrmLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64, H/T), and SepLLM (n=128). The x-axis, labeled "#Iteration," spans from 0 to 140,000 with major tick marks at intervals of 20,000, representing the number of training iterations. The y-axis, labeled "Loss," ranges from 2.4 to 3.4 with major tick marks at intervals of 0.1, indicating the model's loss value. All five lines start at a high loss value of approximately 3.4 at iteration 0 and exhibit a steep initial decline. The "Vanilla" model (purple) shows the highest loss throughout, starting at 3.4 and decreasing to about 2.55 by iteration 140,000. The "StrmLLM (n=64)" (blue) and "SepLLM (n=64)" (orange) lines are very close, both starting at 3.4 and converging to a loss of approximately 2.55. The "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" (green) and "SepLLM (n=128)" (red) lines are nearly identical, starting at 3.4 and converging to a loss of approximately 2.55. All models show a rapid decrease in loss in the first 20,000 iterations, after which the loss stabilizes and continues to decrease slowly.
